output.reason: The brief backs its claim with strong evidence: aps-3 runs 5.8 without the tuning push and stayed at about 94 ms, the euw-1 rollback to 5.7 changed nothing, and disk queue wait jumped when the tuning was pushed, which together point to the compaction tuning change. It also gives a clear, low-risk next step (revert the tuning in one cell, then extend), though the backlog numbers are a bit muddled.
